derivations.quote: Perform both forward transforms and retain their common $LB$ order, with $L$ the layout and $B$ the frequency permutation. Multiply the $M$ pairs of records pointwise there, apply the opposite procedure to that order, and multiply by $M$. Since $LB$ permutes records and leaves polynomial suffixes intact, $P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v)$, so the opposite transform $\mathcal T_+=F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}$ applied to the pointwise product of the stored forward outputs equals $F^+P(F^-f,F^-g)$. The procedure keeps the retained order of [Retained frequency order](frequency-order.md), forming the product there and passing it to the opposite transform. Each record product is formed by [Signed packing](signed-packing.md) in $O(rp\log(rp))$ time, truncated by $Q_p$ to $p$ bits of precision. There are $M=T/r$ pointwise products, so their total cost is $O(Tp\log(rp))$, and the final exact scaling is linear in $Tp$. Each transform costs $O(Tp[dK+pK^{\tau-1}+\ell d^{\lambda'}])$, where $\ell=\log_2r$, $K$ is the layout chunk width, and $\tau,\lambda'$ are exponents from the cost lemma. Put $\delta=\sqrt2\ell\,2^{-p}$ for each forward transform error and $\eta=\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ for one truncation. Let $u,v$ be the exact stored forward outputs, $\widetilde u,\widetilde v$ the returned ones. By bilinearity of $P$ and the disk bound on both operands, $\|P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v)-P(u,v)\|_\infty<2\delta$. After truncation, $\|\widetilde z-z_*\|_\infty<2\delta+\eta$, where $\widetilde z=Q_p(P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v))$ and $z_*=P(u,v)$. Since the opposite transform $\mathcal T_+$ is a contraction with its own error $\delta$, the output error is less than $3\delta+\eta$. The exact multiplication by $M$ gives total error less than $M(3\delta+\eta)=\sqrt2\,M(3\ell+1)2^{-p}$

symbols.name: number of records
symbols.meaning: The number of polynomial records, one per cyclic address of the remaining axes.
symbols.quote: Let $M=\prod_i t_i$ be the number of records, $T=rM$ the number of complex coefficients, and $*$ cyclic convolution.

symbols.name: number of coefficients
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in an array, T = rM.
symbols.quote: Let $M=\prod_i t_i$ be the number of records, $T=rM$ the number of complex coefficients, and $*$ cyclic convolution.
